question: Which reproducible train-only changes improve the W18/GRU lineage or add useful signal to a fixed clean baseline blend?
authority: User explicitly authorizes generating hypotheses and testing on the complete existing 8xL4 cluster, with the established validation contract.

baseline.submitted_weights_for_validation: FORBIDDEN: all train+valid members entered fitting ancestry
baseline.control_resolution: Audit the cached train-only W18/TL3 lineage first. If unavailable, explicitly qualify a fresh clean GRU256x2 reference; no hidden teacher refits or relabelled reproduction.

validation.protocol: ADR0044 official earlier train -> later complete official valid
validation.primary_metric: pooled official clipped-label-magnitude-weighted Pearson, official scored rows, both targets
validation.fit_membership: Official train only; preserve the baseline's source-qualified boundary exclusions if required by its existing contract. Freeze exact membership/hash before admission.
validation.evaluation_membership: All 1873 official validation sequences; never a random fold or seq_ix-ordered split
validation.ancestry: Valid excluded from every normalizer, teacher, initializer, learned preprocessing and blend fitting
validation.exposure: Previously inspected development validation; not a fresh confirmation set
validation.additional_chronological_splits: Require real timestamp/order evidence; never infer order from shuffled identifiers

initial_allocation.design: Four configurations x two matched fitting seeds: one common control and three mechanisms, selected before candidate outcomes
initial_allocation.fixed_primary_endpoint: Freeze from baseline audit and actual-device cost before fitting; log best-observed checkpoints separately
initial_allocation.additional_scientific_fits: Require a separately recorded allocation from the ongoing user authority; no automatic unbounded expansion

resources.initial_workers: One independent fit per admitted GPU; scale only from measured throughput and headroom
resources.local_work: Preparation and bounded CPU tests only; no local GPU training

recipe_invariants: Reuse canonical training components; never clone a trainer
Strict FP32, autocast/GradScaler/TF32 off for this comparison
Exact source/config/data/parent identities frozen before each actual fit
No quantization in research fitting or validation
Preserve all existing stopped/completed fits and historical results
No learned blend coefficients fitted on primary valid

comparison.primary: Per-seed candidate minus matched control at the frozen endpoint, full official valid
comparison.secondary: A predeclared 0.9 clean-reference + 0.1 candidate blend on identical rows; no post-hoc weight tuning
comparison.interpretation: Screening/allocation thresholds, not significance guarantees. Preserve all paired deltas, selection exposure, fixed-prediction uncertainty and incomplete endpoints.

deliverables: Committed diverse hypothesis cards and independent recipe/evaluator review
Actual-device profile with CPU/RAM/VRAM/step throughput and ETA
Detached bounded cohort, no duplicate fits, per-phase status and owned cleanup
Train/control/valid losses and scores, LR, gradients, skipped updates, throughput and resource graphs
Eligible checkpoints, final validation predictions, comparable per-seed table and fixed-blend results
Source/recipe/evidence on GitHub draft PRs targeting research-team
abort: Fitting ancestry touches valid or source/membership identity fails
Nonfinite loss/gradients, repeated OOM, disk reserve or aggregate memory limit breached
Original wave deadline reached: preserve last checkpoints and stop only owned workers
verification_tier: B for conditional exposed-validation comparisons; public/private transfer remains unconfirmed
